description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to user interface interactions, specifically toggling user preference display and handling organization selection modals in a web application.

methods.name: showHideUserPref
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the HTML element with id 'user-details'.

methods.name: selectOrgaOK
methods.description: Handles the selection of an organization by clicking the element with id 'orga' concatenated with orgaName and hiding the modal with id 'selectOrga'.
